messages:
oliver: Heads-up: nebula-liteq:int8 canary failing strict funcall JSON parses. Parse rejects ~1.2% vs 0.02% fp16. Dropping a sample and config. @maya @zack please triage.

maya: Paste config + failing sample pls.

oliver: Canary config: `model=nebula-liteq:int8`, `batch=10`, `kv_cache=on`, `stream_chunk=128`, `retry_budget=1`. Raw model text:

```
{"call": "get_profile", "args": {"user": "u_42",}
```

Trailing comma after user id and sometimes a split `}` across a streaming boundary. Parser error: JSONDecodeError at char 94.

zack: Sounds like token boundary punctuation split from quant emission. Correlates with context length?

oliver: Yes, failures mostly when context >800 tokens or when batch hits 10. Short prompts OK.

maya: Quick experiments: 1) kv_cache off 2) pad one harmless token before payload 3) increase stream_chunk to 256 4) try json-fixer postprocess.

canary-bot: queued mirror: `mirror-1812345678-a` overrides {kv_cache:false}. mirror-b: `pad=//pad1`. mirror-c: `stream_chunk=256`. ETA ~7m.

zack: If pad removes fails that points to tokenizer alignment. json-fixer is cheap guard but measure P99.

canary-bot: mirror jobs completed. Summary: kv_cache_off -> parse down to 0.04%. pad variant -> remaining fails reduced by ~88%. stream_chunk=256 -> minor improvement. json-fixer healed ~62% of leftovers but added ~6ms median, ~28ms P99.

maya: Recommendation: enable 1-token autopad in onboarding harness for nebula-liteq:int8 and run json-fixer only on failure. Add telemetry tag `canary:nebula:int8:funcall-parse`. Hold rollout until healed>=90% in larger mirror.

oliver: Agreed. I'll pause rollout and file ticket with artifacts: https://ci.internal/redwood/canaries/1812345678. Thanks team.

zack: sgtm.

maya: will follow up with quant team for kernel emission diffing.
